findings.finding: Halting on every random tape should be supplemented by an explicit polynomial worst-case runtime and fresh-coin/random-tape convention. Almost-sure halting is not interchangeable.
findings.reason: Every-path halting implies no reachable configuration cycle only under the stated finite-configuration model.

findings.finding: Polynomial runtime and logarithmic classical plus quantum workspace are essential. Unbounded-time bounded-error quantum logspace equals PL.
DLOGTIME direct-connection uniformity is not automatically supplied by a logspace circuit-printing transducer. Retain nonuniform NC1 separately.
Use deterministic adaptive oracle access; P^PP=P^#P as decision classes does not make #P a language class or identify one Boolean PP query with a count.
Each language belongs to some fixed finite counting level; the hierarchy depth must not vary with input length. No unqualified CH-complete-language claim.
Forward: induct on levels; reverse: second level lies in CH.
Let D=P^PP. Inline deterministic oracle computations to show PP^D=PP^PP. Equality C2=D stabilizes C3 and every later level. Reverse is inclusion of C2 in CH.
No converse established: the deterministic-versus-probabilistic outer machine distinction remains. Truth-table closure does not supply adaptive or probabilistic closure.
Distinct NP, PH and PSPACE questions and a broad complete-problem family justify the slot. A problem-specific geometric algorithm need not resolve a whole-class pair.

Finite binary formulas with encoded integer/rational coefficients; arbitrary real inputs/constants or polynomial-bit rational witnesses are different targets. Real-valued quantum amplitudes give no automatic QMA containment.
Corollary24 identifies the exact-soundness-1/2 union with NP. Use the intended inverse-polynomial-gap threshold union; do not assert equivalence across all fixed threshold choices.
Single-node scenario losses do not add to simultaneous-cut losses; independence has no ordinary closure propagation.
